<h1 class="efl-hero__title">Learn English from A1 to C1</h1>

::: {.efl-hero__motto}
Listen more. Speak every day. Think in English. Communicate confidently.
:::

::: {.efl-hero__lead data-lang="es"}
Una ruta de 26 semanas para hispanohablantes de Latinoamérica, centrada en **hablar y escuchar** desde el primer día. Funciona en tu navegador, sin cuenta y sin enviar tus datos a ningún servidor. El calendario es orientativo: avanzar de nivel depende de lo que demuestres, no de las semanas transcurridas.
:::
::: {.efl-hero__lead data-lang="en" hidden="hidden"}
A 26-week path for Spanish speakers from Latin America, centred on **speaking and listening** from day one. It runs in your browser, with no account and no data sent to any server. The calendar is a guide: moving up a level depends on what you demonstrate, not on the weeks that have passed.
:::

<ul class="efl-hero__pills" aria-label="Focus">
<li>A1 → C1</li><li>Speaking 40 %</li><li>Listening 35 %</li><li>Reading 15 %</li><li>Writing 10 %</li>
</ul>

:::
